We have not yet approved any public disclosure or determined which securities filing, if any, will be made. Under our quarterly-close protocol, legal, finance, and insurance counsel each need to report their relevant findings to me before any public filing or release is approved. Once I have all of those findings, I'll finalize the disclosure decision and filing classification without waiting for a separate later confirmation. So I'd like to go around and hear from each of you on what you've found so far. Let's start with finance.
